colombia-documentary-fields.ADDITIONAL: Resolution 2694 already authorized both monitoring and verification of the Government–ELN ceasefire. The Mission expressed willingness to consider Government–EMC verification upon the Secretary-General's confirmation of a ceasefire with appropriate verification protocols, taking into account his update on implementation of Resolution 2694. [ADDITIONAL]
colombia-documentary-fields.BRAZIL: The presiding representative speaking nationally for Brazil stated that the Council should follow the priorities expressed by Colombia's Government. Brazil expressed hope that the Council could authorize verification of the EMC ceasefire later when the situation is sufficiently mature. [BRAZIL]
colombia-documentary-fields.overlap: Brazil and A3 support a possible future Government–EMC verification role subject to a condition, while ADDITIONAL expresses willingness to consider that role with no EMC verification authority granted. Consequently, the shared position remains conditional, and the actual legal status currently grants no EMC verification authority. [BRAZIL, A3, ADDITIONAL] End.
